scope: Author local operating configuration, not automatic portable defaults.

lead.use: scope, implement, integrate, verify, adjudicate, and deliver

critic.use: independent human-facing critique, requirements, accessibility, design coherence and selected complex synthesis; GPT-6.1 Sol verifies findings and retains final authority

architect.use: rare consequential architecture, product vision, and editorial synthesis where stronger failure sequences and false-positive control justify higher latency and Claude context use

design.use: selected ambitious interface/design ownership in an isolated worktree with literal file selection, incremental saves, small final receipt and deterministic verification; GPT-6.1 Sol owns scope, integration and final judgment
